newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 8.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 8.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 3.7 million zlotys.
The following is a summary of block transactions on the Warsaw bourse on Tuesday:
* 8,526 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on February 5, 1997 trading at 101.00 zlotys.
* 16,477 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on May 5, 1997 trading at 101.30 zlotys.
* 10,150 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on February 9, 1998 trading at 102.30.
